perks.name: Mysterious Amulet
perks.tooltip:
Unlocks Zone Automation
Unlocks automatic Item use

perks.name: Minor Time Compression
perks.tooltip:
Tasks reps that are completed instantly (in a single ⏰Tick) now cost 80% less 🔋Energy
Zones where all Tasks are instant without using Items are completed for free in a single ⏰Tick when doing an 🔋Energy Reset
This gives all the benefits doing those Tasks manually would have

perks.name: Reflections on the Journey
perks.tooltip:
Reduce 🔋Energy drain based on the highest Zone reached
In each Zone 🔋Energy consumption is reduced 5% compounding for each Zone you've reached past it
So Zone 12 has 🔋Energy cost multiplied by 0.95^2 if the highest Zone reached is 14

Highest Zone reached: 1
Effect in current Zone: 0% reduction

perks.name: Energetic Memory
perks.tooltip:
On each Energy Reset, increase max 🔋Energy by the current Zone / 10
So Zone 9 gives 0.9 max 🔋Energy

perks.name: Major Time Compression
perks.tooltip:
Tasks with instant reps now complete the whole Task in a single ⏰Tick, rather than a single ⏰Tick per rep
This also means the 🔋Energy cost is that of a single ⏰Tick
Reduces the real-world time for non-instant Tasks by 33% (does not affect 🔋Energy use)

perks.name: Unified Theory of Magic
perks.tooltip:
Each Zone fully completed in this Prestige increases Task Speed 2%
For instance, having fully completed the 15th Zone would speed up Task speed 1.02^15 = 35%
Note that it's based on your highest fully completed, so you can skip fully completing earlier Zones if you want

Highest Zone fully completed currently: 0
Current effect: +0% Task speed

perks.name: Understanding of the Reset
perks.tooltip:
When you run out of 🔋Energy and reincarnate you keep half your remaining Items (rounded up)
This means you can use more Items in a run than just those gained in that specific run

items.name: Food
items.tooltip:
Gives 5 🔋Energy each
Can take you above your Max Energy

Right-click to use all

items.name: Scroll of Haste
items.tooltip: The next Task rep you start is 5x as fast

items.name: Dreamcatcher
items.tooltip: Creates a copy of every Item type you've obtained this Energy Reset (except Dreamcatchers)

items.name: Magic Ring
items.tooltip: The next Task rep you start gives 5x as much XP

items.name: Bottled Lightning
items.tooltip:
The next Boss Task you start is 2x as fast
This stacks with Scroll of Haste

items.name: Army Food
items.tooltip:
Gives 15 🔋Energy each
Can take you above your Max Energy

Right-click to use all

unlockables.name: Divine Inspiration
unlockables.description:
Increases ♟️XP gain by 50% and 🌀Attunement gain by 100%
Note that 🌀Attunement still needs to be unlocked in Zone 10

unlockables.name: Look in the Mirror
unlockables.description:
Permanently unlocks the 🕰️Reflections on the Journey Perk
Boosts its base from 0.95 to 0.9

unlockables.name: Fully Attuned
unlockables.description:
Permanently unlocks the 🌀Attunement Perk
Makes the Divine Knowledge Prestige upgrade apply to 🌀Attunement
Makes 🌀Attunement apply to 🔎Search

unlockables.name: Transcendant Memory
unlockables.description:
Permanently unlocks the 💭Energetic Memory Perk
Squares the Max 🔋Energy gain after Zone 10

unlockables.name: Divine Speed
unlockables.description:
Makes the game tick 1% faster (additively) for every 4 Max 🔋Energy beyond 100
No effect on 🔋Energy use, but makes tasks take less real-world time

unlockables.name: Mastery of Time
unlockables.description:
Permanently unlocks the ⌚Minor Time Compression and ⏰Major Time Compression Perks
1-tick Tasks are now free
1-tick Tasks (except Travel) are now automatically completed when you enter a Zone
The auto-completion is not applied to Zones you've not set to be automated (in case you want to do things like use a Magic Ring)

unlockables.name: See Beyond the Veil
unlockables.description:
Unlocks five new tasks before Zone 20
Boss Tasks no longer get removed from Automation on Prestige

unlockables.name: Perky
unlockables.description:
Every Perk unlocked increases Task Speed by 1% (multiplicative)
Current effect: +0%

unlockables.name: Compulsive Notetaking
unlockables.description:
Start every reset with at minimum 2 of each of 🐇Scrolls of Haste, 📚Books, 🛠️Crafting Recipes, 📜Divine Notes, and 🕊️Griffin Quills
Takes effect if you would keep fewer of the given Item on Energy Reset

unlockables.name: Limitless Power

Multiplies 💪Power and 🌀Attunement Gain by 5
Doubles ✨Divine Spark Gain

unlockables.name: Divine Supremacy

Makes Mandatory Tasks 5x faster

Increases Max 🔋Energy by 1000
Doubles ✨Divine Spark Gain

repeatables.name: Divine Lightning

One more level would increase ✨Divine Spark gain at Zone 19 by 34%, and -53% at Zone 1

repeatables.name: Transcendant Aptitude
repeatables.description:
Increases starting skill levels by 100
🙏Ascension has its starting level increased by only half

repeatables.name: Energized

Increases the 🔋Energy gain from 💭Energetic Memory by 5%
